description:
🎯 Top 5 Things to AVOID After Applying for a Mortgage 🏡❌

1️⃣ Don’t switch bank accounts 🏦Keep your accounts steady! Lenders need to track your funds easily.

2️⃣ Don’t open or close credit accounts 💳🚫Any change to your credit can affect approval — no new cards, no closures!

3️⃣ Don’t make big purchases 🚗🛋️Hold off on buying that car or new furniture. It could mess with your debt-to-income ratio.

4️⃣ Don’t co-sign loans ✍️⚠️You’ll take on more debt — and lenders will notice.

5️⃣ Don’t make large, unexplained deposits 💰❓Lenders need clear documentation. Unverified deposits = delays.

📌 Save this for later!📲 Share with someone getting ready to buy a home in Central Texas!
